panels.title: Milestones observed in selected window
panels.description: ROUTED means cold data activated; COMPLETE is a separate outcome. Includes only events observed after scrape history begins; journal migration baseline is not an event in this window.

panels.title: Last known job milestones
panels.description: Zero/unknown historical timestamps are hidden.

panels.title: Current jobs carrying errors
panels.description: Current unresolved errors in unfinished jobs, not cumulative failed attempts.

panels.title: Failed or canceled attempt rate
panels.description: Process-local attempts reset on restart; waits are excluded.

panels.title: Scheduler errors
panels.description: Selection/journal errors since process start.

panels.title: Jobs by durable next-step state
panels.description: Durable state is the next step, not necessarily an executing operation.

panels.title: Executing attempts
panels.description: Current execution, zero after restart; waits do not count as completed attempts.

panels.title: Active attempt age
panels.description: Only executing attempts. The synchronous scheduler can remain unchanged during these operations.

panels.title: Waiting jobs
panels.description: Distinct blocked jobs reconstructed from current journal/configuration and retry state.

panels.title: Next retry
panels.description: Zero means no scheduled retry.

panels.title: Oldest unfinished job age
panels.description: Hidden when no unfinished job or its creation time is unknown.

panels.title: Cold routing frontier
panels.description: Exclusive boundary, not an Influx deletion watermark.

panels.title: Retention-adjusted routing lag
panels.description: Routing lag beyond configured hot retention, not deletion lag. Day boundaries add up to one day of scheduling granularity.

panels.title: Pending late records
panels.description: Pending late records

panels.title: Oldest pending late record age
panels.description: Oldest pending late record age

panels.title: Quarantine records
panels.description: Population retained for investigation; not a count of newly quarantined events.

panels.title: Average observed attempt duration
panels.description: Process-local observed wall time; no value when no finished attempts.

panels.title: Attempt samples in selected window
panels.description: Use counts to assess sparse-stage duration statistics.

panels.title: Observed attempt duration p95
panels.description: Bucket approximation; sparse samples do not establish a reliable tail percentile.

panels.title: Pending hot deletions
panels.description: May be intentional while deletion is disabled or readers are draining.

panels.title: Writer permits and expired rows
panels.description: Protecting permits include expiry drain grace. Expired rows no longer block archival; broker redelivery recovers unacknowledged writes.

panels.title: Reader leases including grace
panels.description: Active reader leases and expiry grace still blocking deletion.

panels.title: Expired unreleased reader rows
panels.description: Diagnostic rows past expiry/grace; they no longer block deletion.

panels.description: Go process RSS only; child/container memory requires separate exporters/profiling.

panels.title: API reader lease renewal (separate API targets)
API target availability
panels.description: API targets are selected separately from loader targets. Missing API renewal series require the matching API build and its own scrape job.

panels.title: API renewal outcomes
panels.description: API process-local attempts; network/validation errors and cancellation are distinct from accepted renewals.

panels.title: Average API renewal latency
panels.description: Background renewal latency, not data-query duration or total response latency. No completed attempts means no average.

panels.title: API renewals observed in selected window
panels.description: Counts observed within this time range after scraping begins; counters reset on API restart.
